Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 83 now!
Synopsis :
Matsaal Dev reveals to the Pipliwan soldiers about Chandragupta being alive giving them a reason to fight against Dhananand. Chandragupta encourages them with his inspiring words and his goal to seek avenge from Dhananand becomes everyone’s aim. Meanwhile, Mura escapes from Dhananand's palace with Chandravardhan's armour and meets the soldiers. Mura handovers the responsibility of a king to fight for his and his country men's respect to Chandragupta. Dhananand gets enraged after learning about Mura's escape.
